description: This file defines the GatewayPushSubscription enum which contains static methods for subscribing to push notifications from a gateway connection, handling task restart, and processing incoming push data asynchronously.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to a push notification stream and executes a callback on each push received. Handles task cancellation and executes callback on the main actor context.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Cancels an existing task and starts a new task that consumes push notifications, using the provided callback. Ensures execution on the main actor context.
